info.name: KC Realm-Per-Tenant E2E
info.description:
End-to-end testing of the Keycloak realm-per-tenant architecture.

Each DIGIT tenant root (pg, mz) is a KC realm. Cities (pg.citya, pg.cityb) are KC groups within the realm. All 21 DIGIT roles are provisioned as realm roles.

Workflow:
1. KC Admin Login (master realm)
2. Verify realm structure (pg realm, roles, groups, client)
3. Enable direct-access-grants on digit-ui client (for Postman testing)
4. Create test user in pg realm
5. Assign roles (GRO, PGR_LME, EMPLOYEE)
6. Assign user to city group (pg.citya)
7. Get user JWT via password grant
8. Decode & verify JWT claims (groups, realm_access)
9. Call token-exchange-svc health check
10. Proxy PGR search through token-exchange-svc
11. Proxy PGR create through token-exchange-svc
12. Verify DIGIT user was lazy-provisioned
13. Cleanup: disable direct-access-grants

Variables:
- keycloakUrl: KC base URL (with /auth prefix)
- tokenExchangeUrl: token-exchange-svc URL
- adminUsername / adminPassword: master realm admin
- testRealm: realm to test (default: pg)
- testCity: city group (default: pg.citya)
